title: Flasque sheaves are acyclic for topological cohomology
statement: Let X be a topological space, and on the site of open subsets of X with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] let F be a flasque abelian sheaf [def-sc-zariski-flasque], meaning every restriction map F(V) \to F(U) for opens U subseteq V is surjective. Then H^q(X,F)=0 for every integer q>0 [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], where H^q is the right derived functor of global sections on sheaves of abelian groups on this site.

source.place: Lemma 09SY (lemma-flasque-acyclic), specialized to the opens site of X

proof.text: The site of open subsets of X with open coverings is exactly the topological (Zariski) site used by [lem-sc-zariski-flasque-acyclic]. By [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], its cohomology is the right derived functor of global sections, while the cited lemma computes the same derived functor by an injective-resolution model. Therefore its vanishing statement gives H^q(X,F)=0 for every q>0.
